---
title: "My Solutions"
---

```{r include=FALSE}
repo_name <- basename(getwd())
current_filename <- xfun::with_ext(knitr::current_input(), "qmd")
pages_base_url <- paste0("https://byuim443.github.io/",repo_name,"/")
issues_url <- paste0("https://github.com/BYUIm443/",repo_name,"/issues")
  
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

#Locate all html files, and put them in a table. 
my_files <- 
  list.files(pattern = "P\\..+html") %>%
  tibble(name = .) %>%
  mutate(ChPr = str_extract(name, "(?<=P\\.)[:digit:]+\\.[:digit:]+")) %>%
  separate(ChPr, into = c("Chapter","Problem"), sep = "\\.") %>% 
  mutate(Chapter = Chapter %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(Problem = Problem %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(url = paste0("<a href='",pages_base_url,name,"' target='_blank'>",name,"</a>")) %>% 
  arrange(-Chapter,-Problem) %>% 
  select(Chapter, Problem, url)
```

```{r results='asis', echo = FALSE}
cat("-   Link to [GitHub Issues](",issues_url,")\n")
cat(paste0("-   Last modified: ",Sys.Date()))

```

## Table of Submissions

Here's my solutions in a table. Note that qmd files must be saved in the form `P.x.qmd` or `E.x.x.x.qmd` for them to appear in this list.

```{r echo=FALSE}
DT::datatable(my_files, 
              escape = FALSE, 
              rownames=FALSE,
              options = list(pageLength = 10))
              
```

```{r include=FALSE}
##Save the list above for use in class-wide list.
write_csv(my_files %>% mutate(author = repo_name),"file_list.csv")

```
